segments.name: Remittance services
segments.description: Operates a cross-border remittance hub for bank partners, corporate clients and migrant workers, settling payments globally.
segments.evidence: The remittance segment is operated through Tranglo.

segments.name: Sales of airtime
products: cross-border airtime wholesale and transfer services
segments.description: Sells and transfers airtime and data top-ups to retail users and migrant workers through Tranglo and WalletKu.
segments.evidence: The Company operates the airtime segment via its international airtime transfer business through Tranglo and its retail airtime trading business locally in Indonesian through WalletKu.

revenueModel.text: Business-to-business partners, corporate clients and retail users pay transaction and foreign exchange fees for cross-border remittance and airtime transfer services.
revenueModel.evidence: At December 31, 2025, Tranglo had more than 5,000 bank partners, 35 e-Wallets, 130,000 cash pick-up points, and more than 140 corporate clients for remittances, with a remittance network covering more than 100 countries.

changes.text: In 2026 the company announced it had agreed to sell its controlling interest in Tranglo to New Margin.
changes.evidence: On January 2, 2026, in connection with the Proposed Merger, we announced that our wholly owned subsidiary, Seamless, entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to sell its 60% controlling interest in Tranglo to New Margin.
